findings.description: Decision 66's 'One pattern' paragraph still says SESSION_ID_PATTERN is exported from src/core/session-activity.constants.ts, beside STALLED_AFTER_MS, but this delta moved it into a new src/core/paths.constants.ts and STALLED_AFTER_MS is now that file's only export.
findings.body:
This delta moves `SESSION_ID_PATTERN` out of `src/core/session-activity.constants.ts` into a new `src/core/paths.constants.ts` (all three importers — `paths.utils.ts`, `dashboard.service.ts`, `session-dossier.service.ts` — follow it there), but decision 66's own prose wasn't updated to match:

> *One pattern.* `SESSION_ID_PATTERN` — `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/` — is exported from `src/core/session-activity.constants.ts`, beside `STALLED_AFTER_MS`, the other rule both the readers and the watchdog share.

`session-activity.constants.ts` now contains only `STALLED_AFTER_MS`; the pattern isn't there and isn't 'beside' anything. `docs/09-decisions.md` is this repo's authoritative record (AGENTS.md: it "wins over 00-08 where they conflict"), and this is the same decision entry this delta already edited once to fix a different inaccuracy — so a reader following this sentence to find `SESSION_ID_PATTERN` lands in the wrong file.

Permalink: <https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/25939875fe8a8830f9bb3a76baac7a19a4ad243c/docs/09-decisions.md#L3349-L3351>
findings.suggestion:
*One pattern.* `SESSION_ID_PATTERN` — `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/` — is exported from
    `src/core/paths.constants.ts`, the rule the readers, the watchdog, and `sessionFragment` all
    share. `dossierFileName` now tests against it instead of its own

findings.description: The docstring's citation '(decision 66; decision 51 gave dossier file names the same rule)' misattributes decision 51, which is actually about the session code-graph/MCP index, not dossier file names — this mis-citation predates this delta and was only carried over verbatim from the deleted session-activity.constants.ts docstring.
